newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU puzzled by new US WTO grain panel request.
newsitem.headline: EU puzzled by new US WTO grain panel request.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was puzzled by the United States intention to again ask the World Trade Organisation (WTO) to set up a panel to hear a complaint against the EU's grain import tariff system.
Trade sources in Geneva said that Washington had requested a new panel which will be on the agenda of a meeting of the WTO's Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on Thursday.

"It's incomprehensible," a Commission spokesman said, noting that Washington withdrew its panel request last month after the EU agreed to change its rice import system and to open a new tariff quota for U.S. malting barley.

Washington renewed the panel request on March 26 but has now withdrawn it and resubmitted another in what U.S. diplomatic sources have said was a procedural ploy to keep up pressure on the EU while avoiding the immediate creation of a panel.
The U.S. must withdraw the panel request before May 1 if the two EU measures are to be implemented, the spokesman added.
"We have fulfilled our side of the deal. The decisions have been taken and member states cannot unravel them," the spokesman said, adding the decisions were due to be finalised this month.
Washington is concerned that the EU has not yet published either a new cumulative recovery system for rice imports, which allows traders to reclaim excess import duties, nor the malting barley quota.
